title: Halves and Quarters
introduction: Divide a whole into equal parts.
definition: Divide a whole into equal parts.

examples.question: How many halves make a whole?
steps: Two equal halves make one whole.

examples.question: How many quarters make a whole?
steps: Four equal quarters make one whole.

exercises.question: How many halves make a whole?
exercises.solution: Two equal halves make one whole. Answer: 2

exercises.question: How many quarters make a whole?
exercises.solution: Four equal quarters make one whole. Answer: 4

exercises.question: Write one of two equal parts as a fraction.
exercises.solution: One out of two equal parts is 1/2. Answer: 1/2

exercises.question: Write one of four equal parts as a fraction.
exercises.solution: One out of four equal parts is 1/4. Answer: 1/4

summary: Divide a whole into equal parts.
